scope: chat:what does a grower need to move host fruit out of the zone?

gemini.value:
Interstate movement of host fruit from a quarantined area is prohibited except in accordance with federal fruit fly regulations [7cfr301_32#000], [mexfly_hosts#002]. Regulated articles may be moved under a permit issued by the Administrator with attached permit tags/labels, or via a limited permit issued by an inspector if specified handling, processing, or utilization will destroy life stages [7cfr301_32#018], [7cfr301_32#024]. Crops like Hass avocados must also meet specific orchard sanitation and safeguarding requirements [7cfr301_32#018]. The La Mesa quarantine area itself currently contains no commercial agriculture [2026-04-02_la-mesa-expanded-da-2026-16#001].

The sources don't settle this. They do not detail intrastate movement rules, specific approved treatments, or exact compliance agreement steps for growers. Confirm details with CDFA, the San Diego County Agricultural Commissioner, or USDA APHIS.
